citations.claim: EW yellow active at step 96, one second before end
first yellow_duration violation at final step 97 with only 1s of yellow observed

counterfactual.change: actuated true->false; fixed-time does not gap-out EW green at step 95 so no truncated yellow at end of run

explanation: Actuated control gaps out EW green at step 95 when queues empty, starting EW yellow at step 96. Run ends at step 97 so only 1s of yellow is observed before all-red, violating yellow_seconds=3. Fixed-time with same timings stays green and shows no violation.
vision_note: The green direction holds green through steps 94-95, turns yellow at step 96, then is already red at step 97. The yellow is thus visible for only one second before all-red instead of the required three seconds.
